grammar.0.note: I-message: say your feelings/needs, don't blame the other person. „Es wäre schön/hilfreich, wenn …“ is a polite request.
grammar.1.note: Missed possibilities or regret in the past. „Wenn ich es gewusst hätte, wäre ich gekommen.“ (If I had known, I would have come.)
grammar.2.note: Taking the steps in order keeps a conflict from escalating and makes a solution easier. Don't forget to say thank you at the end.
quiz.4.options.0: I should have said it earlier
quiz.4.prompt: What does „Ich hätte es früher sagen sollen“ mean?
quiz.9.prompt: Put the sentence in order: “I would like to bring something up.”
